Name: Nueske's Applewood Smoked Boneless Turkey Breast- Medium (3 lbs.)
Natural: Nueske's Applewood Smoked Boneless Turkey Breast-Med. (3 lbs.) - Starting with birds especially bred for abundant white meat, these plump breasts are carefully boned and slowly Smoked over glowing Applewood embers for 24 hours. The result is a moist & tender, completely boneless breast imbued with Nueske's sweet, yet smoky, signature flavor. The perfect choice to highlight of your memorable meal, buffet or party table. Available in three sizes to accommodate gatherings from intimate to large. Not a water-added product.
